bugs.description: INJECTED (return-value-dropped): Return value dropped in an exported function; callers still use the result. `return <value>` replaced by an empty return in `emptyObject` (callers still consume the result). Mutated packages/server/src/unstable-core-do-not-import/utils.ts:45: `return Object.create(null);` -> `return;`. The bug manifests in packages/server/src/unstable-core-do-not-import/http/contentType.ts:86: `return emptyObject();`.
